description: This file provides helper functions for generating standardized API responses, including success responses ('ok' and 'created') and error responses, with predefined theming (colors, theme name) for a project called 'Ocean Professional'.

methods.name: ok(res, data = {}, meta = {})
methods.description: Generates a 200 OK JSON response with theme and color styling, including data and meta information.

methods.name: created(res, data = {}, meta = {})
methods.description: Generates a 201 Created JSON response with theme and color styling, including data and meta information.

methods.name: error(res, httpStatus = 400, code = 'bad_request', message = 'Request invalid', details = null)
methods.description: Generates an error JSON response with customizable HTTP status, code, message, and details; includes theme and color styling.

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^function error(res, httpStatus = 400, code = 'bad_request', message = 'Request invalid', details/
ctags.signature: (res, httpStatus = 400, code = 'bad_request', message = 'Request invalid', details = null)
